payload.statement: RESOLVED 2026-09-04: the rejected N-0010 'Actions / ranked commercial actions' framing folds into Attention as a cross-domain surfacing and routing layer. N-0010 does not survive as its own work container. Binding terms: (1) Attention surfaces and routes; work completion happens in the owning domain, never from Overview; no approve/resolve/edit of any entity from Attention. (2) Items are DERIVED; they clear when the underlying condition clears (work done, or a justification recorded against the entity in its own domain); no dismiss and no snooze. (3) Assignment is a property of the entity, not the queue; Attention shows and filters by owner (mine / my domain / all) and does not reassign; filtering is the superuser mechanism; no separate notification system. (4) Signals group by shared entity using the existing entity graph, not inference; multiple symptoms of the same CPOR case, lineup or customer render as one situation; cross-entity clustering is future work. (5) Two signal classes: CONDITION (wrong now) and PROJECTION (will be wrong unless acted on by a computed date; value decays past that date). (6) Signal history is retained from the start; projections need learnt cycle times from our own history; items persist with lifecycle appeared/changed/resolved/expired and are not recomputed and discarded on each read. (7) The reasoning is the payload: every item shows the evidence chain, not only the conclusion. (8) Audit covers the system as well as people: record what the platform asserted, when, and from what evidence. Scope: domain modules are not redesigned; Attention composes from existing platform capability and must reuse existing projection inputs (transit history, cover, lineup planning, cycle times) rather than reimplement them; permitted domain touches are deep-link route targets with filters preserved, and a justification-recording affordance where a domain has none; a missing projection input is a separate slice — report and stop. The 2026-09-02 proposal to charter Promotions & Funding / Market & Listings / template-profile nodes as N-0010's split, and to keep ranked commercial actions as a slimmed re-chartered planned node, is not accepted. Those surfaces remain D-0008 domain architecture. No nodes chartered by this recording. Evidence: .eif/audit/NS6_D0009_20260904/OPERATOR_DECISION.md.
